notes: Every song in an album now shows that album cover beside it, instead of only the first song having a picture.
The line that says a song could not be played now has Restart beside it on the albums page, the playlists page and every list, instead of naming a button that was not on screen.
A copy that stopped early now goes straight to the copy that can hold the whole song, and a search that came back empty is asked once more before the app reports that nothing could be found.
